title: Equitable expands retirement plan offering with introduction of Retirement Milestones℠ T. Rowe Price Series
summary: New York – September 15, 2026 – Equitable, a leading financial services organization and principal franchise of Equitable Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: EQH), today announced the introduction of the Retirement Milestones℠ T. Rowe Price Series, the first target-date investment option available through Retirement Milestones,℠ a new series of collective investment trust (CIT) solutions in collaboration with strategic investment managers.
body_markdown:
1 Sway Research, *The State of the Target-Date Market: 2025* , February 2025.


Reference to the 1859 founding applies specifically and exclusively to Equitable Financial Life Insurance Company. Equitable is the brand name of the retirement and protection subsidiaries of Equitable Holdings, Inc., including Equitable Financial Life Insurance Company (Equitable Financial) (NY, NY); Equitable Financial Life Insurance Company of America (Equitable America), an AZ stock company with an administrative office located in Charlotte, NC; and Equitable Distributors, LLC.


**IMPORTANT INFORMATION**


The Retirement MilestonesSM T. Rowe Price CIT is a collective trust fund established and maintained by Benefit Trust Company (BTC) under a declaration of trust for investment solely by qualified retirement trusts and governmental plans. T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc., a registered investment adviser, serves as the sub adviser for the Retirement MilestonesSM trust series, serving institutional clients. T. Rowe Price, Equitable Financial Life Insurance Company (Equitable Financial) and Benefit Trust Company are not affiliated. T. Rowe Price and related indicators (see troweprice.com/ip) are trademarks of T. Rowe Price Group, Inc. T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc. is the advisor to the trust. Not a bank deposit and not insured or guaranteed by any bank, government entity, the FDIC or any other type of deposit insurance. You should carefully consider the investment objectives, risk, charges and expenses of the trusts before investing. BTC is a non-depositary trust company with operations in Overland Park, Kansas.


The Equitable Retirement AccessSM defined contribution program consists of a custodial account offered through Benefit Trust Company, as well as a group fixed annuity contract issued by Equitable Financial. Distributors: Equitable Distributors, LLC and Equitable Network, LLC (Equitable Network Insurance Agency of California, LLC; Equitable Network Insurance Agency of Utah, LLC; Equitable Network of Puerto Rico, Inc.). All guarantees associated with the fixed annuity are based on the claims-paying ability of Equitable Financial. Equitable Financial and Equitable Distributors: 1345 Ave. of the Americas, NY, NY 10105. A Retirement Gateway® annuity contract is a group flexible premium combination fixed and variable deferred annuity issued by Equitable Financial. Co-distributed by affiliates Equitable Advisors, LLC (member FINRA, SIPC) and Equitable Distributors, LLC. The Equitable Retirement Vision® defined contribution program consists of a custodial account offered through Benefit Trust Company, within which plan participants’ chosen mutual fund shares are held, as well as a group fixed annuity contract issued by Equitable Financial. Distributed by Equitable Distributors, LLC (NY, NY). Investments are subject to investment risks, including possible loss of the principal invested. They are not insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation nor are they deposits to, obligations of, or guaranteed by any bank.


**About Benefit Trust Company:**


Benefit Trust Company (“BTC”) was formed with the single-minded fiduciary focus of delivering services to corporations, institutions and executives. Our core offerings include sponsoring CITs, custom benefit plans,[trustee and custodial services](https://benefittrust.com/our-services/?service=Trustee%20Services#services) ,[trading platforms](https://benefittrust.com/our-services/?service=Trading#services) ,[portfolio unitization](https://benefittrust.com/our-services/?service=Unitization#services) , investment management, and[collective trust services](https://benefittrust.com/our-services/?service=Collective%20Investment%20Trust#services) . We ensure the proper blend of comprehensive delivery and security of assets through custody, trust and transaction services combined with the knowledge and dedication of world-class professionals. BTC is a privately held Institutional Trust company, founded in 2002. Since inception, we have excelled in every aspect of the trust business. With expertise to handle the ordinary and flexibility to create the extraordinary.
